EV Battery Manufacturing

Supporting the Future of Electrification

Industry Overview

The global transition towards electrification continues to accelerate demand for advanced battery manufacturing facilities. These environments require highly controlled conditions, specialised utility systems and scalable infrastructure to support evolving production technologies, safety requirements and operational efficiency. As manufacturing capacity expands worldwide, facility performance and reliability remain critical to achieving sustainable, high-volume production.

IAQ Key Capabilities
Dry Room Facilities
Manufacturing Infrastructure
Critical Utility Systems
EPC Delivery
Why Production Readiness Matters

Battery manufacturing requires specialised environments, stringent safety controls and highly coordinated facility operations to support large-scale production.

Delivered in this market

Published EV battery projects from the sample registry, from European gigafactory dry rooms to lithium cell facilities in Southeast Asia.
